mistakes.mistake: Draft plan listed test fixtures under drafts/hook-rehearsal/, but the tests synthesize fixtures in a temp dir
mistakes.solution: plan text updated in the implementation status; no committed rehearsal folder

mistakes.mistake: kling-preflight only recognised --submit-only, while kling_batch.py's default mode submits every selected job; a lane could spend without preflight
mistakes.solution: every kling_batch.py call without --resume is a paid submission; direct CLI generation verbs are refused

mistakes.mistake: Schema slot check counted images in a dict request, but real specs are JSON lists of jobs; the R08 check never fired
mistakes.solution: parse the list, select --only jobs, count images per job

mistakes.mistake: canonical-guard used fnmatch where * crosses slashes, denying nested manifest.json files storyboard and downloads legitimately write
mistakes.solution: match path parts one by one; match suffixes for paths outside the worktree

mistakes.mistake: media-guard let destructive commands through when no protected folder was named (git clean, git reset --hard, /bin/rm, find -delete)
mistakes.solution: always deny git clean and reset --hard; match rm after a slash; protect projects/; evaluate each command segment separately

mistakes.mistake: no-retry matched generation_id, which neither specs nor --resume carry; it never denied on real input
mistakes.solution: match job names against stored intent/submit/response files and the ledger shot_id column

mistakes.mistake: Layer 2 reservation check parsed a status shape agent-parley does not emit (counts only) and added up to 3 s per edit
mistakes.solution: dropped; Parley's own reserved_path denial covers reservations

mistakes.mistake: mistakes.jsonl M-02 asserted 'about 62 credits', a figure present in no source; AGENTS.md forbids invented charges
mistakes.solution: cost rewritten to the sourced facts (two 41-credit charges, 70 vs 30 delta) with no total
mistakes.rule_added: lint-free rule: numbers in the register must cite a source row
